steps.description:
Show that your robot can do the following using ultrasonic sensor:
1. The robot will move forward at the speed of 100
2. The robot will stop moving when the distance between the ultrasonic sensor and obstacle is less than 10cm away.

Show that your robot can do the following using ultrasonic sensor:
1. The robot will move forward at the speed of 100 if no obstacle is detected within the range of 50cm
2. The robot will slow down and move forward at the speed of 75 when the obstacle is within 50 cm away from the car.
3. The robot will stop moving when the distance between the ultrasonic sensor and obstacle is less than 10cm away.
